senses.gloss: m. (עדק; cmp. חָדַק, a. preced. wds.) something squeezed together, compress.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 54b:11">Sabb. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>טומנין לה ע׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="P00419"><he>עֲזָק</he></cite>; Ms. O. <cite ref="P01444"><he>עֲרָק</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70) we dip a compress in oil for her and put it &c.—Pl. <he>עֲדָקִין</he>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 54b:11">Ib.</cite> <he>שני ע׳ בשמן</he> (not <he>של שמן</he>; ed. <he>עֲזָקִין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90).—[<he>עדקין</he>, <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 27:19">Targ. Ezek. XXVII, 19</cite> some ed., v. <cite ref="P01445"><he>עַרְקָא</he></cite>.—
